text: The blood results show significant thrombocytosis with abnormal platelets, which, combined with your smoking history and symptoms of digital pain and dizziness, strongly suggests a myeloproliferative disorder. text: RESULTS: Bone_Marrow_Aspirate: Presence of dysplastic megakaryocytes. Genetic_Testing: Mutation on chromosome 9. Iron_Studies: Serum_Iron Decreased, Iron_Saturation Decreased, Serum_Ferritin Decreased, Total_Iron_Binding_Capacity Increased.

speaker: Doctor
text: The bone marrow findings of dysplastic megakaryocytes combined with the specific genetic mutation on chromosome 9 strongly confirm Essential Thrombocythemia, while the low iron studies explain your current fatigue. Your symptoms of digital pain and dizziness are classic vascular complications of this condition. DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Thrombocythemia
